request.description: Admin login with email and password. Returns JWT token and user data.
Admin logout. Requires authentication.
Get current authenticated admin user information.
Get dashboard statistics including stats, user growth, order trends, top vendors, and recent activity.

query.description: Search term for username, email, or full name

request.description: Get all users with optional filters. Status: active (approved & not deleted), suspended (deleted), deleted (deleted).
Get detailed information about a specific user.
Suspend a user by setting deletedAt. User will receive a notification.
Activate (unsuspend) a user by clearing deletedAt. User will receive a notification.
Delete a user (soft delete by setting deletedAt).
Change user role. Valid roles: customer, bakery_owner, restaurant_owner, driver, admin. User will receive a notification.
Verify a user account.
Unverify a user account.
Get all vendors (bakeries and restaurants) with optional filters.
Get detailed information about a specific vendor (automatically detects bakery or restaurant).
Get all vendors with pending_approval status.
Approve a pending vendor. Automatically detects bakery or restaurant. Owner will receive a notification.
Reject a pending vendor. Owner will receive a notification with the reason.
Suspend a vendor by setting deletedAt. Owner will receive a notification.
Activate (unsuspend) a vendor by clearing deletedAt. Owner will receive a notification.

query.description: pending | confirmed | preparing | ready_for_pickup | out_for_delivery | delivered | completed | cancelled
Search term (order number, customer name, etc.)

request.description: Get all orders with optional filters.
Get detailed information about a specific order.
Update order status. Valid statuses: pending, confirmed, preparing, ready_for_pickup, out_for_delivery, delivered, completed, cancelled. Customer will receive a notification.
Cancel an order. Cannot cancel delivered or completed orders. Customer will receive a notification.

variable.description: JWT token for admin authentication. Automatically set after admin login.
